definitions.role: path method 'baseline' -> dense-baseline; 'threshold' with end sparsity 0.0 -> dense-threshold; 'threshold' > 0 -> pruned
definitions.cohort: launch batch: experiment ids sorted, new cohort when the id gap > 100; named C<first id>. Builder-defined (PREREG names cohort but does not define it).
definitions.complete: data+index in bucket, index md5 ok, data size == max(offset+size) in index, convert.to_torch accepts the tensor set (53 conv weights+53 masks for threshold; 53 kernels for baseline; 53 BN; final_dense)
definitions.bytes_needed: data + index bytes (the .meta graph is not needed by convert.py)

sources.role_sparsity: checkpoint path segments, as documented in bucket README.md section 'Interpreting the Checkpoint Path' and parsed by Hooker code pie_dataset_gen/imagenet_predictions.py (split[11]=method, split[12]=fraction)
sources.tstat: prior-gate/g13/tstat.csv == bucket wide_all_aggregated1569137618.33_recall_precision_t_statistic.csv (md5 Jz/r129+H06s3tU1mMXiXw== matches listing); one row per model x class, model fields repeated
sources.index_files: bucket .index files (downloaded to data/bucket_meta/index/, md5-verified, parsed with prior-gate/g13/ckidx.py)
